icon-revanced.description: Key Points on Icon Pack Studio Morphed. It unlocks pro features in the Icon Pack Studio app, allowing free access to advanced icon editing tools without subscriptions, Compatible primarily with version 2.2 build 016, though community reports suggest testing on newer builds like 2.3 for stability. Enhances customization for Android themes, but use may violate app terms; always verify with original APK sources.Icon Pack Studio ReVanced modifies the original app by the Smart Launcher Team to provide premium capabilities at no cost. This includes creating custom icon packs with extra effects, textures, gradients, and filters for professional designs. Users can import, edit, and export packs seamlessly, supporting launchers like Nova and Action for cohesive device themes.
